mapper.select: SELECT LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, PROTCL_CD AS protclCd FROM web_link_sys_info WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY FIELD(LINK_SYS_CD,'EMS_TX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC','PBX','VMS'), LINK_SYS_NM
SELECT STN_CD AS stnCd, STN_NM AS stnNm FROM com_stn_info WHERE USE_YN='Y' ORDER BY STN_SEQ

SELECT M.ems_id*10 + CASE T.dataSeCd WHEN 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS clctCycleSn, L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, T.dataSeCd AS dataSeCd, CASE T.dataSeCd WHEN 'P' THEN '성능 수신' ELSE 'PING 수신' END AS dataSeNm, CASE WHEN T.dataSeCd='P' THEN 'Gateway / Usage' ELSE 'Gateway / ICMP' END AS performanceProtocol, 'ICMP' AS pingProtocol, NULL AS perfClctUseYn, NULL AS pingMntrUseYn, NULL AS clctCycleSec, NULL AS sttsMntrCycleSec, NULL AS timeoutSec, NULL AS rtryNocs, NULL AS timeoutPollSec, NULL AS totalJgmtSec, CASE T.dataSeCd WHEN 'P' THEN U.lastDt ELSE P.lastDt END AS lastExcnDt, NULL AS nextExcnDt, CASE WHEN (CASE T.dataSeCd WHEN 'P' THEN U.lastDt ELSE P.lastDt END) >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS useYn, CASE WHEN T.dataSeCd='P' THEN 'raw_usage_log 수신 기준' ELSE 'raw_ping_log 수신 기준' END AS cycleCrtrCn, COALESCE(D.deviceCount,0) AS targetEqpmntCount, CASE WHEN T.dataSeCd='P' THEN COALESCE(U.recentCount,0) ELSE COALESCE(P.recentCount,0) END AS recentCount FROM com_ems_info M JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=(CASE M.ems_id WHEN 1 THEN 'EMS_TX' WHEN 4 THEN 'VMS' WHEN 11 THEN 'PBX' WHEN 13 THEN 'EMS_PIDS' WHEN 16 THEN 'SCADA_SEC' ELSE '' END) CROSS JOIN (SELECT 'P' AS dataSeCd UNION ALL SELECT 'C') T LEFT JOIN (SELECT ems_id,COUNT(*) AS deviceCount FROM com_device_info WHERE use_yn='Y' GROUP BY ems_id) D ON D.ems_id=M.ems_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ems_id, MAX(reg_dt) AS lastDt, SUM(reg_dt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)) AS recentCount FROM raw_ping_log GROUP BY ems_id) P ON P.ems_id=M.ems_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ems_id, MAX(reg_dt) AS lastDt, SUM(reg_dt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 5 MINUTE)) AS recentCount FROM raw_usage_log GROUP BY ems_id) U ON U.ems_id=M.ems_id WHERE M.use_yn='Y' AND M.ems_id IN #{id} AND L.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} AND T.dataSeCd=#{dataSeCd} ORDER BY FIELD(L.LINK_SYS_CD,'EMS_TX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC','PBX','VMS'), T.dataSeCd

SELECT L.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd, L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, DATE_FORMAT(R.reg_dt,'%H') AS hourLabel, COUNT(*) AS executionCount,COUNT(*) AS successNocs,0 AS failNocs, 'NORMAL' AS execSttsCd FROM ( SELECT ems_id,reg_dt FROM raw_ping_log WHERE reg_dt >= CURDATE() UNION ALL SELECT ems_id,reg_dt FROM raw_usage_log WHERE reg_dt >= CURDATE() ) R JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=(CASE R.ems_id WHEN 1 THEN 'EMS_TX' WHEN 4 THEN 'VMS' WHEN 11 THEN 'PBX' WHEN 13 THEN 'EMS_PIDS' WHEN 16 THEN 'SCADA_SEC' ELSE '' END) WHERE R.ems_id IN #{id} AND L.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} GROUP BY L.LINK_SYS_CD,L.LINK_SYS_NM,DATE_FORMAT(R.reg_dt,'%Y-%m-%d %H') ORDER BY FIELD(L.LINK_SYS_CD,'EMS_TX','EMS_PIDS','SCADA_SEC','PBX','VMS'), MIN(R.reg_dt)

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_usage_log) AS rawCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM raw_receive_log) AS interfaceCount, (SELECT MAX(reg_dt) FROM raw_usage_log) AS latestRawDt, (SELECT MAX(recv_dt) FROM raw_receive_log) AS latestReceiveDt, NULL AS defaultCycleSec
mapper.sql: T.THRSHLD_SN AS thrshldSn,T.THRSHLD_PROFILE_NM AS profileNm, T.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,L.LINK_SYS_NM AS linkSysNm, K.perfIdctCd AS perfIdctCd,K.perfIdctNm AS perfIdctNm,'%' AS unitNm, T.INFO_VL AS infoVl,T.WARNING_VL AS warningVl,T.LOW_VL AS lowVl, T.HIGH_VL AS highVl,T.EMERGENCY_VL AS emergencyVl, COALESCE(T.CONTN_NOCS,3) AS contnNocs,COALESCE(T.USE_YN,'Y') AS useYn
(SELECT 'CPU_USGRT' AS perfIdctCd,'CPU 사용률' AS perfIdctNm UNION ALL SELECT 'MMRY_USGRT','MEMORY 사용률') K
mapper.select: SELECT FROM JOIN web_thrshld_info T ON T.PERF_IDCT_CD=K.perfIdctCd LEFT JOIN web_link_sys_info L ON L.LINK_SYS_CD=T.LINK_SYS_CD WHERE 1=1 AND (T.LINK_SYS_CD=#{linkSysCd} OR T.LINK_SYS_CD IS NULL) AND (K.perfIdctCd=#{keyword} OR K.perfIdctNm LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY K.perfIdctCd,T.THRSHLD_SN

SELECT T.THRSHLD_SN AS thrshldSn,T.THRSHLD_PROFILE_NM AS profileNm, T.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,T.PERF_IDCT_CD AS perfIdctCd, CASE T.PERF_IDCT_CD WHEN 'CPU_USGRT' THEN 'CPU 사용률' ELSE 'MEMORY 사용률' END AS perfIdctNm, '%' AS unitNm,T.INFO_VL AS infoVl,T.WARNING_VL AS warningVl, T.LOW_VL AS lowVl,T.HIGH_VL AS highVl,T.EMERGENCY_VL AS emergencyVl, T.CONTN_NOCS AS contnNocs,T.USE_YN AS useYn FROM web_thrshld_info T WHERE T.THRSHLD_SN=#{_parameter}

SELECT T.THRSHLD_SN AS thrshldSn,T.THRSHLD_PROFILE_NM AS profileNm, T.LINK_SYS_CD AS linkSysCd,T.PERF_IDCT_CD AS perfIdctCd, CASE T.PERF_IDCT_CD WHEN 'CPU_USGRT' THEN 'CPU 사용률' ELSE 'MEMORY 사용률' END AS perfIdctNm, '%' AS unitNm,T.INFO_VL AS infoVl,T.WARNING_VL AS warningVl, T.LOW_VL AS lowVl,T.HIGH_VL AS highVl,T.EMERGENCY_VL AS emergencyVl, T.CONTN_NOCS AS contnNocs,T.USE_YN AS useYn FROM web_thrshld_info T WHERE T.PERF_IDCT_CD=#{_parameter} ORDER BY T.THRSHLD_SN LIMIT 1
